description: Our app has multiple pages each one giving more details about sea levels , trends in our planet and more
summary: Earth trends explorer is an interactive, multi-page web platform designed to bridge the gap between raw satellite telemetry and public understanding. By guiding users through dedicated, story-driven modules—covering global sea level rise, long-term planetary trends, and localized environmental shifts—our app transforms decades of Earth observation data into intuitive visual narratives.
details:
1. What does it do or how does it work?

Earth Trend Detective is an interactive website that uses NASA data to explore Earth's climate, weather, natural disasters, and satellite imagery. It combines NASA APIs to make environmental information easy to understand and explore.

2. What benefits does it have?

It raises environmental awareness, helps users understand climate change and natural disasters, and makes scientific data accessible for students, researchers, and the public.

3. What is the intended impact of the project?

Our goal is to educate people about Earth's changing environment, encourage climate awareness, and inspire communities to take action to protect our planet.

4. What tools, coding languages, hardware, or software did you use?

  • HTML, CSS, and JavaScript
  • NASA POWER API
  • NASA EONET API
  • NASA EPIC API
  • Three.js / WebGL for 3D visualization, where applicable
  • Visual Studio Code and Netlify
  • Computer and internet connection

5. How is your project creative?

It transforms complex NASA data into an interactive experience using visualizations, satellite imagery, climate insights, and 3D Earth exploration. It makes learning about our planet engaging and accessible.

6. What factors did your team consider?

We focused on data accuracy, user-friendly design, accessibility, performance, educational value, and the project's potential to create environmental awareness.

Our mission is simple: Make Earth data understandable, inspire curiosity, and encourage people to protect our planet.
